deals.name: Red Heat Tavern

deals.name: Dave & Buster's
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon–Fri 4–7 PM. $5 Tres Tequila Rita, house wine, Long Island tea and 22 oz domestic drafts. Late-night $5 happy hour after that.
